## Data Preprocessing
```{r}
## Convert to Factors
shop$Revenue <- as.factor(shop$Revenue)
shop$Month <- as.factor(shop$Month)
shop$TrafficType <- as.factor(shop$TrafficType)
shop$VisitorType <- as.factor(shop$VisitorType)
shop$Weekend <- as.factor(shop$Weekend)
shop$OperatingSystems <- as.factor(shop$OperatingSystems)
shop$Browser <- as.factor(shop$Browser)
shop$Region <- as.factor(shop$Region)
```



```{r}
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(shop)

# Create 50-25-25 split
train_index <- sample(1:n, size = 0.5 * n)
remaining_index <- setdiff(1:n, train_index)

val_index  <- sample(remaining_index, size = 0.25 * n)
test_index <- setdiff(remaining_index, val_index)

train <- shop[train_index, ]
val   <- shop[val_index, ]
test  <- shop[test_index, ]

# One Hot encoding
train_x <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ ., data = train)[, -1]
val_x   <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ ., data = val)[, -1]
test_x  <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ ., data = test)[, -1]

# Remove any zero-variance columns
nzv <- apply(train_x, 2, var) == 0
train_x <- train_x[, !nzv]
val_x   <- val_x[, !nzv]
test_x  <- test_x[, !nzv]

train_y <- train$Revenue
val_y   <- val$Revenue
test_y  <- test$Revenue

# Standardize numeric columns 
num_cols <- apply(train_x, 2, is.numeric)
train_means <- apply(train_x[, num_cols], 2, mean)
train_sds   <- apply(train_x[, num_cols], 2, sd)

train_x[, num_cols] <- scale(train_x[, num_cols], center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
val_x[, num_cols]   <- scale(val_x[, num_cols], center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
test_x[, num_cols]  <- scale(test_x[, num_cols], center = train_means, scale = train_sds)

```

```{r}
## F1 score func for eval
f1_score <- function(pred, truth, positive = "TRUE") {
  
  pred  <- factor(pred, levels = levels(truth))
  truth <- factor(truth, levels = levels(truth))
  
  tp <- sum(pred == positive & truth == positive)
  fp <- sum(pred == positive & truth != positive)
  fn <- sum(pred != positive & truth == positive)
  
  precision <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fp))
  recall    <- ifelse(tp + fn == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fn))
  
  if (precision + recall == 0) return(0)
  
  2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
}
```

## Models
```{r}

# Linear SVM
library(e1071)      
library(tidyverse)  
library(MLmetrics)  

lams <- 10^seq(-3, 1.5, by = 0.5)  # Cost grid
lin_acc <- numeric(length(lams))
lin_f1  <- numeric(length(lams))

for (i in seq_along(lams)) {
  svmfit <- svm(
    x = train_x,
    y = train_y,
    kernel = "linear",
    type = "C-classification",
    cost = lams[i],
    scale = TRUE,
    max.iter = 1e7 
  )
  
  # Predict on validation set
  val_pred <- predict(svmfit, val_x)
  
  # Metrics
  lin_acc[i] <- mean(val_pred == val_y)
  lin_f1[i]  <- f1_score(val_pred, val_y, positive = "TRUE")
}

# Collect results
lin_results <- data.frame(
  cost     = lams,
  accuracy = lin_acc,
  f1       = lin_f1
)

# Best cost based on validation F1
best_lin <- lin_results[which.max(lin_results$f1), ]
best_lin

# Train final linear SVM on train + validation
final_x <- rbind(train_x, val_x)
final_y <- factor(c(as.character(train_y), as.character(val_y)), levels = levels(train_y))

lin_svm_model <- svm(x = final_x, y = final_y, kernel = "linear",type = "C-classification",
  cost = best_lin$cost, scale = TRUE)

# Evaluate on test set
pred <- predict(lin_svm_model, test_x)
table(Predicted = pred, Actual = test_y)
lin_accuracy <- mean(pred == test_y)
lin_f1       <- f1_score(pred, test_y)
lin_accuracy; lin_f1
```


```{r}
## Cost v f1 Plot

ggplot(lin_results, aes(x = log10(cost), y = f1)) +

  labs(
    title = "Linear SVM: Validation F1 vs log10(Cost)",
    x = "log10(Cost)",
```

```{r}
## Gaussian SVM
library(e1071)

# parameter grids
sigs <- c(0.0005, 0.001, 0.002, 0.005)
lams <- 10^seq(-3, 0, by = 0.5)

ss <- length(sigs)
rr <- length(lams)

ksvm_acc <- rep(NA, ss * rr)
ksvm_f1  <- rep(NA, ss * rr)
id <- 0

for (i in 1:ss) {
  for (j in 1:rr) {
    id <- id + 1
    
    svmfit <- svm(
      x = train_x,
      y = train_y,
      scale = FALSE,
      type = "C-classification",
      kernel = "radial",
      gamma = sigs[i],
      cost  = 1 / lams[j]
    )
    
    # Predict on validation set
    val_pred <- predict(svmfit, val_x)
    
    # Accuracy & F1
    ksvm_acc[id] <- mean(val_pred == val_y)
    ksvm_f1[id]  <- f1_score(val_pred, val_y, positive = "TRUE")
  }
}

# Collect results
svm_results <- data.frame(
  gamma    = rep(sigs, each = rr),
  lambda   = rep(lams, ss),
  accuracy = ksvm_acc,
  f1       = ksvm_f1
)

best_svm <- svm_results[which.max(svm_results$f1), ]
best_svm

# Train final SVM on train + validation set
final_x <- rbind(train_x, val_x)
final_y <- factor(c(as.character(train_y), as.character(val_y)), levels = levels(train_y))

svm_model <- svm(x = final_x,y = final_y,scale = TRUE,type = "C-classification",kernel = "radial", gamma = best_svm$gamma, cost  = 1 / best_svm$lambda)

# Evaluate on test set
pred <- predict(svm_model, test_x)
table(Predicted = pred, Actual = test_y)
g_accuracy <- mean(pred == test_y)
g_f1       <- f1_score(pred, test_y)
g_accuracy; g_f1

```

```{r}
svm_results <- data.frame(
  gamma   = rep(sigs, each = rr),

)

svm_results
```

```{r}
## Random Forest Model
library(randomForest)

# Combine training + validation
final_rf_x <- rbind(train_x, val_x)

  c(as.character(train_y), as.character(val_y)),
  levels = levels(train_y)
)

# Train
rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = final_rf_x,
  y = final_rf_y,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(final_rf_x))),
  importance = TRUE
)


print(rf_model)
pred <- predict(rf_model, test_x)
table(Predicted = pred, Actual = test_y)

rf_accuracy <- mean(pred == test_y)
rf_f1       <- f1_score(pred, test_y, positive = "TRUE")

rf_accuracy
```

```{r}
## KNN
library(class)

k_values <- c(1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200)

train_f1 <- numeric(length(k_values))
val_f1   <- numeric(length(k_values))

for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
  k <- k_values[i]
  
  # Training predictions
  train_pred <- knn(
    train = train_x,
    test  = train_x,
    cl    = train_y,
    k     = k
  )
  
  train_f1[i] <- f1_score(train_pred, train_y, positive = "TRUE")
  
  # Validation predictions
  val_pred <- knn(
    train = train_x,
    test  = val_x,
    cl    = train_y,
    k     = k
  )
  
  val_f1[i] <- f1_score(val_pred, val_y, positive = "TRUE")
}

knn_results <- data.frame(
  k        = k_values,
  train_f1 = train_f1,
  val_f1   = val_f1
)

knn_results

best_k <- knn_results$k[which.max(knn_results$val_f1)]
best_k

final_pred <- knn(
  train = rbind(train_x, val_x),
  test  = test_x,
  cl    = factor(c(as.character(train_y), as.character(val_y))),
  k     = best_k
)

knn_accuracy <- mean(final_pred == test_y)
knn_f1       <- f1_score(final_pred, test_y, positive = "TRUE")

knn_accuracy
knn_f1

df <- nrow(train_x) / k_values

## Plot DF v f1
plot(df, train_f1,
     type = "b",
     col = "#08519C",
     pch = 19,
     ylim = range(c(train_f1, val_f1)),
     xlab = "Degrees of Freedom (n / K)",
     ylab = "F1 Score",
     main = "KNN Training and Validation F1")

lines(df, val_f1,
      type = "b",
      col = "#85C9B2",
      pch = 19)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Training F1", "Validation F1"),
       col = c("#08519C", "#85C9B2"),
       pch = 19)


```
